This project developed streamline the checkout experience and online payment processing so customers can easily and safely pay how they want and wherever they are. Customers can use a wide array of payment options, including credit and debit card processing, mobile payments, and online payment gateways. Offers advanced fraud protection, data security, and insightful analytics to help businesses optimize their payment processes and enhance customer experiences. By integrating innovative technology and comprehensive support, this project aims to simplify and streamline transactions, driving growth and efficiency for its clients across various industries.

fields.value: Apptio, a leading TBM SaaS platform used by enterprises to manage and optimize IT financial operations. Built scalable backend services that supported financial modeling, cloud cost optimization, and IT planning across large-scale infrastructures. Leveraged Spring Boot, JPA, REST APIs, Java 8, and multithreading to deliver high-performance solutions, while integrating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases. Implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, automated deployments, and used Kafka for distributed message processing. Worked extensively with AWS services including RDS, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis, and SNS to build cloud-native, event-driven architectures. Improved application performance by optimizing complex SQL queries and ensuring secure, scalable deployments. Provided on-call production support, resolved critical issues, monitored system health, and contributed to documentation.

fields.value: B2BBridge is a centralized booking and tracking system with an automated dispatching and handling mechanism. Multiple Cab Agencies can connect and handle their bookings with their software. It provides some feature like intercity bookings, Airport bookings, Outstation bookings, Cab for Bus Bookings, Public shared taxi (PST) and Posting bookings, Posting Vehicles to other Cab agencies with their mutual understanding. 3rd party APIs for map and SMS are used in this project.
